trap.label: verbo + -ing / can’t
trap.wrong: I keep to try, I had repaired my laptop, and it can’t be Leo yesterday.
trap.right: I keep trying, I had my laptop repaired, and it can't have been Leo yesterday.
trap.why: Mesmos hábitos do português: infinitivo após keep, “consertei” por contratar e “não pode ser” para o passado. Em inglês: keep + -ing; have + obj + pp; can’t have been.

fix.wrong: I had repaired my phone (por alguém).

fix.right: It can’t have been Mia yesterday.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com keep: “He continues to call.”
Reescreva: “A plumber fixed my sink.” (I had...)
Reescreva no passado: “It can’t be Leo.”
